_comment: Определения, примеры, части речи и транскрипции, выверенные вручную. Нужны там, где Cambridge не знает фразу целиком (arrival hall), отдаёт не то значение (gate → часть забора, deposit → глагол) или помечает словосочетание как collocation. Значения отсюда имеют приоритет над найденными онлайн. Применяется скриптом npm run words:backfill.

arrival hall.definition: the large area in an airport where passengers come out after they have landed and collected their bags
arrival hall.example: My parents were waiting for me in the arrival hall.

bell boy.definition: a hotel employee whose job is to carry guests' bags to and from their rooms
bell boy.example: The bell boy carried our suitcases up to the room.

business suite.definition: a large hotel room with a separate area where you can work or meet people
business suite.example: The company booked a business suite for the meeting.

miss a bus.definition: to arrive too late to get on a bus
miss a bus.example: I missed the bus this morning and had to walk to work.

parking pass.definition: a card or ticket that allows you to leave your car in a particular car park
parking pass.example: Hotel guests can get a free parking pass at the front desk.

reception desk.definition: the desk near the entrance of a hotel where guests check in and ask for help
reception desk.example: Please leave your key at the reception desk when you go out.

return policy.definition: the rules of a shop about when and how you can bring back something you have bought
return policy.example: Check the return policy before you buy the jacket.

wake up.example: I wake up at seven o'clock every morning.

leave home.definition: to go out of your house, especially at the start of the day
leave home.example: I leave home at half past seven to catch the train.

gate.definition: the place in an airport where you get on your plane
gate.example: The flight to Rome leaves from gate 12.

connection.definition: a train, bus, or plane that leaves soon after another one arrives, so that you can continue your journey
connection.example: We had only 40 minutes to catch our connection in Paris.

on time.definition: not late; at the time that was planned
on time.example: The train arrived exactly on time.

delayed.example: Our flight was delayed by two hours because of the snow.

card payment.definition: a payment you make with a bank card instead of cash
card payment.example: Card payment is faster than counting out coins.

medium.definition: of middle size, between small and large
medium.example: I'd like a medium T-shirt, please.

exchange.definition: when you give back something you have bought and take a different thing instead
exchange.example: The shop offered an exchange because the shirt was too small.

boarding pass.example: Please show your boarding pass at the gate.

cashier.example: The cashier gave me my change and a receipt.

fitting room.example: Can I try these jeans on in the fitting room?

window seat.example: I always book a window seat so I can look out at the clouds.

baggage claim.example: We waited for our suitcases at baggage claim.

customs.example: We had nothing to declare, so we walked straight through customs.

size.example: What size shoes do you wear?
